NotOwner(address,address).details: Thrown when non owner tries to access an only-owner function

params.sender: The msg.sender who is not the owner

postUpgradeInit(address,bytes32,address).details: A osp breaking change is introduced as part of Stylus upgrade, where the new osp would not support      pre-Stylus legacy wasmModuleRoot. To ensure that the new osp is not used for legacy wasmModuleRoot,      we introduce a conditional OSP where condRoot should be set to the pre-Stylus root and condOsp should      be set to the pre-Stylus osp. The correct value should be handled by the upgrade action contract.

bisectExecution(uint64,(uint256,uint256,.notice: Initiate the next round in the bisection by objecting to execution correctness with a bisection of an execution segment with the same length but a different endpoint. This is either the initial move or follows another execution objection

getOsp(bytes32).notice: Get the OSP for a given wasm module root

osp().notice: Get the default osp, which is used for all wasm module roots that don't have a conditional OSP set         Use getOsp(wasmModuleRoot) to get the OSP for a specific wasm module root
